This is the train to the city centre, calling at Green Park, Museum Street and Central Station. The next stop is Green Park. Please mind the gap between the train and the platform, and hold your children by the hand. If you are going to the airport, do not stay on this train: change at Central Station and take the blue line, direction west. Tickets are checked on this train, so please keep your ticket with you until the end of the journey. For the buses, come out of Central Station on the main side, and the stops are in front of you: number 12 goes to Oxford Street every ten minutes. The next stop is Green Park.

Hello, this is the taxi company, calling to confirm your car for tomorrow morning. You asked for four o'clock in the morning, to the airport, for four people with three bags. That is confirmed, and the driver arrives five minutes early and waits in front of the hotel. Two things, please. First, the fare to the airport at that hour is fifty pounds, and you can pay by card in the car. Second, if you have a lot of bags, tell us now, because for more than four bags we send a bigger car and it is ten pounds more. If you need to cancel, please call before midnight, because after that we charge half. The driver's name is Dave and he speaks slowly for our visitors. Thank you.
Good evening. Take me to this address, please. How much is it to Oxford Street? Could you open the boot? We have three bags. Stop here, please. Thank you very much.
